decision.summary: A multi-sample co-shift in N and E occurs near index 620 (N ↑~2.0, E slight ↓), persisting through index 624 with no clear opposing return observed within allowed context. Subsequent drift (625–650) shows partial counter-motion but not full reversal; status remains uncertain due to ambiguous recovery. No confirmed temporary offset interval meets onset-sustained-return criteria.

intervals.observation: N jumps from ~27.5 to ~29.5 (Δ≈2.0) and E shifts from ~-13.5 to ~-13.6 (small Δ), both sustained over 4–5 samples (indices 620–624); U shows no coherent step. Return not observed before index 624; later N/E continue drifting but without clear reversal of the jump magnitude.

From ~625 to 650, N declines slightly (~29.5→27.0) while E rebounds (~-13.6→-11.1), suggesting partial opposing motion; however, this does not constitute a clean return to pre-jump levels (N remains >27, E remains >-12). No axis shows full recovery to pre-620 state.
